source_geometry_morphology.method: Count geometry component and ring statistics from the pinned source ADM2 feature for direct units and administrative predecessor for ecology-derived subjects. This is a descriptive screen only.
source_geometry_morphology.interpretation: No scoped predecessor is represented as GeoJSON MultiPolygon in these pinned sources. This does not show that an island or detached territory is present in the source; the source itself can omit land and the eco portions are separately clipped or partial records. Two Polygon sources have an interior ring; no full shore/island completeness comparison was run.

name_and_anonymous_remainder_screen.interpretation: All scoped source features have a nonempty named source shapeName; that does not identify every unmatched out-of-scope or unnamed territorial remainder. Exact source roster remainders are separately listed in assessment.json.

city_and_parent_granularity_candidates.finding: One named metropolitan district occurs in the cohort; no settlement/city footprint comparison was done.
Candidate special/single-child urban administration requiring role/source review; see scale-screens.json. No city footprint comparison was done.
Candidate special/single-child urban administration requiring role/source review; see scale-screens.json. No city footprint comparison was done.

Nine named ADM2 features (Riyadh, Ksar, Dar Naim, Arafat, El Mina, Sebkha, Teyarett, Tevragh Zein, Toujounine) fall under the same-name source ADM1 parent by point/name screen. This suggests an urban parent cohort, but no official city footprint, source-code crosswalk or complete polygon overlay was evaluated.

parent_cohort_scale.method: Count exact assigned subjects under each scoped province-parent ID; not an Atlas size threshold or completeness measure. Full per-parent list is province-assessments.json.
parent_cohort_scale.interpretation: These are workload counts only; they do not independently flag an oversized administrative group.

repeated_tier_and_large_unit_candidates.interpretation: Bamako is exactly geometry-equal to the same-name source ADM1; Nouadhibou is a 90.16% spherical source-area screen relative to Dakhlet Nouadhibou and a single-child point parent. Neither establishes geometry or tier error.

neighbor_context.status: Existing shared-source OCHA WCA edge screen reports no positive area overlap for Senegal-Mauritania and Senegal-Mali at its stated precision. This screen is not a crosswalk of the different vintage country ADM2 sources and is not a shared-boundary approval.

unassessed_completeness: No independent current city/urban footprint source was inspected for Greater Monrovia, Bamako, Nouadhibou, or Nouakchott.
No authoritative full-settlement gazetteer, all-land/outer-island inventory, detached-territory source, or coastal low-water source was acquired for any country.
No complete polygon overlay against current legal ADM2 and ADM1 extents was run.
No source evidence establishes that all direct locations are optimally chosen functional/administrative atlas tiers or that ecoregion extents are full clipped intersections.
limits: All morphology/scale/name signals are screens, not geographic proof.
An absence of MultiPolygon geometry is not evidence of island completeness.
Counts are limited to this packet’s exact scope, except where source roster remainder is explicitly reported.
No regional certificate, approval, boundary edit, publication or import is authorized.
